visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair sits on a white textured couch, wearing a light blue t-shirt with Stitch graphics. To her left sits a large blue Stitch plush. She holds a small purple and blue rectangular box featuring a 'Sleeping Series' Stitch illustration. The lighting is bright and even, typical of an indoor living room setting. (2) She uses her hands to peel back the cardboard lid of the box, revealing a silver foil packet inside. She reaches in and pulls out a small pink figurine, showing a surprised and happy facial expression. The camera zooms in slightly on the box and her hands. (3) The shot cuts to a extreme close-up of the figurine, which is a pink character (Angel) lying on a white cloud base. The woman rotates the object to show different angles. (4) The woman holds the figurine next to her face, smiling and talking. She then turns the original purple box around to point at the back, which displays illustrations of nine different possible figures in the set. (5) The scene shifts to a white display shelf crowded with various Stitch and Disney collectibles. The woman's hand enters the frame and places the new Angel figurine into a vacant spot among the other toys. The lighting remains bright studio-style throughout.

(2) A sharp crinkling sound of plastic and cardboard tearing occurs as the box is opened. The female voice expresses excitement. (3) A male voice enters the mix, speaking with a lower pitch but a playful, teasing tone, questioning the woman's luck. (4) The female voice continues at a high speech rate, describing the features of the toy. The BGM remains consistent in the background.
